scientific_integrity: The formula is proved by acyclic spoke/rim decomposition, path-source enumeration, and a separate global-rim correction. Independently implemented finite tests confirm explicit degree histograms, counts, extremal multiplicities, Lucas formula, and the edge-count identity. Previously known total orientation counts and general zonotope face counts are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary labelled wheel acyclic orientations under one-edge reversals only; symbolic formula applies to each integer m>=3. Numerical programs exhaust only their documented finite ranges. An unindexed historical equivalent degree enumerator is not excluded.
title: Degree distribution of the wheel acyclic-orientation flip graph
